title: geotagFromTrack
body:
## geotagFromTrack

Geotag photographs into new copies of the same container from GPX tracks: each photo is placed at its capture instant by great-circle interpolation between consecutive timed fixes of a validated track, using the recorded or declared offset and an optional declared clock correction, with gap, overlap, speed and endpoint rules, a track report, a geotag plan and independent proofs. The native geotag feature is never used.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The photo instant depends on the camera clock and offset: a wrong clock gives a wrong position, so reconcile and correct the clock first or declare the correction.
- The path between fixes is unknown: interpolation is a straight great-circle estimate, no accuracy or confidence is claimed, and nothing is extrapolated, bridged across a gap or taken from another segment or track.
- GPX is untrusted XML: DTDs, entities and external references are refused, zoneless times need an explicit rule, and invalid points are refused or excluded by policy. WGS-84 is assumed for GPX 1.1 only; a GPX 1.0 datum must be declared.
- A photo that cannot be placed is copied unchanged or refused by policy with its reason; check each item's outcome, because a run can be partly successful.
- A correctTime plan used as the clock correction moves the placement instant by the plan's own before and after states (an offset kept to the instant moves nothing; one kept to the wall clock moves it); an item the plan could not correct is refused rather than placed on its uncorrected time.

Native binding: `one perl exiftool -config "" -n process per item: the same fixed coordinate assignments as setLocation, from positions Schemaxis interpolated on captured GPX tracks (no native -geotag, -geosync or expression is used); -o stage/ID.jpg captured/ID.jpg`. Output kind: `["image","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `apply` | write (default) writes the new copies and publishes the plan with the report; plan publishes the plan and the reports without writing any copy. The plan can be applied later with the plan option, and only to the captures it was made for. | `{"type":"enum","values":["write","plan"]}` | omitted |
| `tracks` | The GPX track files the photos are placed on (1 to 8). Each is captured byte for byte before any parsing and its SHA-256 is recorded in the plan. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":8,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64}}}}` | omitted |
| `photoTime` | How the instant of each photo is derived from its recorded capture wall time: the capture time minus the recorded (or assumed) offset, moved by a declared clock correction that applies to the placement only. The photo's own time fields are not rewritten. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"source":{"type":"enum","values":["captured"]},"assumedOffsets":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"group":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"offset":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":8,"required":true}}}},"clockCorrection":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"enum","values":["none"]},{"type":"object","properties":{"shifts":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"group":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"shift":{"type":"object","properties":{"days":{"type":"integer","minimum":-40000,"maximum":40000},"hours":{"type":"integer","minimum":-1000000,"maximum":1000000},"minutes":{"type":"integer","minimum":-100000000,"maximum":100000000},"seconds":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24}},"required":true}}}},"plan":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}]}}}` | omitted |
| `groups` | How photos are grouped into camera clocks. By default photos are grouped by the exact recorded make, model and body serial text; declare members to group by your own names instead (for example two bodies of one model). A group is the unit that receives one skew or one correction. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"by":{"type":"enum","values":["recordedDevice","declared"],"required":true},"keys":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":3,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":["cameraMake","cameraModel","bodySerialNumber"]}},"members":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"group":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32}}}}},"itemOverrides":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"item":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"group":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true}}}}}}` | omitted |
| `interpolation` | Limits on placing a photo between track fixes. Defaults are conservative: no snapping, a 300 second gap limit and a 5 metre overlap agreement. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"maxGapSeconds":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":3600},"endpointSnapSeconds":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":60},"overlapAgreementMeters":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24}}}` | omitted |
| `track` | How the GPX content is read: invalid points, times without a zone, elevation and the datum of a GPX 1.0 file. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"invalidPoints":{"type":"enum","values":["refuse","exclude"]},"zonelessTimes":{"type":"enum","values":["asSchema","refuse","utc"]},"elevation":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"enum","values":["ignore"]},{"type":"object","properties":{"reference":{"type":"enum","values":["seaLevel","ellipsoidal"],"required":true}}}]},"datum1_0":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32}}}` | omitted |
| `policies` | How to resolve choices the data cannot decide. The accepted members depend on the operation: editMetadata (iptc, otherLanguages, exifEncoding, companionLoss), correctTime (sourceConflicts, preferFamily, subSecond, uncorrectedItems), setLocation (staleCompanions, xmp, createExif, altitudeNotExpressible, removeDirection, uncorrectedItems) and geotagFromTrack (those of setLocation plus gpsStamp and maxSpeedMetersPerSecond). Every member is optional; the effective plan echoes all of them with their defaults. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"staleCompanions":{"type":"enum","values":["remove","keep"]},"xmp":{"type":"enum","values":["ifPresent","always","remove"]},"createExif":{"type":"enum","values":["allow","refuse"]},"altitudeNotExpressible":{"type":"enum","values":["refuse","omitAltitude"]},"removeDirection":{"type":"boolean"},"uncorrectedItems":{"type":"enum","values":["copyUnchanged","refuseSlot"]},"gpsStamp":{"type":"enum","values":["photoInstant","none"]},"maxSpeedMetersPerSecond":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24}}}` | omitted |
| `plan` | Absolute path of a plan document published earlier by this operation with apply: plan. The run applies exactly that plan: the plan carries every other input of its operation, so combining it with them is refused, an edited plan is refused as inconsistent, and a capture that changed since the plan was made is refused as stale. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}` | omitted |
